subject: HANDOFF V2: visual security authorization revalidated on committed Gen3 alpha1
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-security-rd-visual-security-authorization-20261002. This V2 supersedes the earlier handoff whose final main was f925daab. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. FINAL_MAIN_SHA=179e688e234fd54cedf99aa7792c86de00bba947. MAIN_CHANGED_DURING_RND=YES. Gen3 alpha1 (versionCode 38, versionName 3.0.0-alpha1-zfold7) is now committed into app/** and was directly re-audited. FINDING_STILL_APPLIES: SnapshotCache remains bitmap+age only with a 15-minute generic bridge window; FoldOverlayService.onAccessibilityEvent remains Unit; PanelEngine still permits cached bridging and on secure screenshot failure can leave stale bridge pixels displayed; Fold7ContinuityFrameStore CaptureTicket/FrameLease still carry no security epoch; Fold7Gen3VisualCoordinator/Fold7CoverVisualHost carry no keyguard/device-lock/security authorization gate; DuoShellService still reports containsSecureLayers but ShizukuBridge still collapses secure=true into null. Therefore exact-cycle Gen3 provenance does not prove security authorization. GEN2_DIRECTION=service-stable monotonic securityEpoch + exact capture/frame epoch + fail-closed secureCaptureQuarantine; lock/keyguard changes and explicit secure capture denial revoke older pixels; only a fresh successful current-context capture clears quarantine under a new epoch. MODEL=15/15 PASS plus fixed-seed 100,000-operation adversarial invariant run. DEVICE_OCCURRENCE=UNVERIFIED; Fold7 field validation required.
